text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, {0}!
You free right now?
We're gonna play house, so you should join in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん、お兄ちゃん！
　今ヒマ？
私たちと一緒に、オママゴトしようよ！

text_block_list.name: Pukichi
text_block_list.text:
\"I know you might be a bit too old
to play a baby game like house, kid,
but you'll do it for Ayane and Kurumi, won't ya?\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
『おままごとなんて、子どもっぽいことに
坊ちゃんを付きあわせるのも悪いんだけどよ、
アヤネとクルミのために、頼むぜ』

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You can't, because you're going exploring today?
Oh... that's a shame...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
　今から探検に行くから無理なんですか？
ざ、
残念ですぅ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Misteeeer! We're here to pick you up!
Are you ready to explore, or aren't you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～い、にいちゃーんっ！
　
迎えに来たよ～！
　
早く一緒に探検に行こうよー！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's the girls from Little Lyrical...
When you said you were going exploring, did you mean with them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれっ？
　【リトルリリカル】のみんなだ……
もしかして探検に行くのって、
【リトルリリカル】と一緒なの？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Exploring is one of our guild activities!
Misogi says we should explore the Tower of Luna today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
探検は【リトルリリカル】のギルド活動なんだ～
ミソギちゃんの提案で、
今日はルナの塔に登ろうって。

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, huh.
So it's not a real exploring job or anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な～んだ。
別にお仕事で探検に行くわけじゃないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, \"big bro\"! ♪
Forget all that exploring stuff, and come play house with us instead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇお兄ちゃん♪
探検なんかやめて、
アヤネ達とオママゴトしようよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
\"Big bro\"?
If he's anyone's big bro, he should be mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『お兄ちゃん』？
{0}にいちゃんは、ミソギのにいちゃんだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Eheheh... You'll be my big bro, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
ミミのおにいちゃんだよね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Stop that, you two!
How many times do I have to tell you
he's a very suspicious creep?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと二人とも！
　この人はへんたいふしんしゃさんだと
何度も言ってるでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: I-I don't think our big bro is suspicious or a creep at all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お兄ちゃんは、
へんたいでもふしんしゃでもないですよぅ……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text: That's right! He's our awesome big bro!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ！
　私たちのお兄ちゃんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
No he's not!
He's our big bro, not yours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちがうもんっ！
ミソギたちのにいちゃんだもん！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
That does it.
We'll decide which guild makes the best little sisters
the old-fashioned way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなったら……
どっちのギルドがにいちゃんの妹にふさわしいか、
勝負だ！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text: Oh, a battle? I'm game for that! You'll never beat us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その勝負、
受けて立った！
　
負けないんだからっ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh? Huuuuh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　え？
　
えー？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: You're not taking our Mr. Nice Bro!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんは、
渡さないんだから！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: I-I can't just let you steal him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私だって、
負けないもん……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Ummm...
I'm actually quite fine with not being {0}'s sister...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの……
私は別に、
{0}さんの妹になりたいわけじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll settle this at the Tower of Luna!
If you think you're taking our big bro, think again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、決戦の舞台は、
ルナの塔ね！
にいちゃんの妹の座は
渡さないぞ～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
So it was that the Tower of Luna
became the stage for a grand battle of wits
between Little Lyrical and the Sarendia Sisters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔を舞台に、
【リトルリリカル】と【サレンディアシスターズ】の、妹対決が幕を開ける！
